prose.text: Shift leads need a daily report showing short picks per picker to target retraining and reduce errors.
Sam manually builds a weekly Excel report from WMS exports, taking about four hours; the WMS dashboard only shows building totals.
Automate a daily report per picker, per shift, per day, ready by 6am, using WMS pick confirmations and the defined short pick rules.
Exclude over picks and any customer or pricing data; cancelled lines do not count.
If the new report disagrees with WMS numbers two weeks in a row, Sam will revert to the manual spreadsheet.

acceptance.given: WMS pick confirmations are available and the report is generated by 6am
acceptance.when: the report shows short picks per picker, per shift, per day, following the defined rules
acceptance.then: shift leads can use it to select pickers for retraining

acceptance.given: the report numbers disagree with WMS pick confirmations for two consecutive weeks
acceptance.then: the report is switched off and the manual spreadsheet is used instead

guardrails.text: If the numbers in the new report disagreed with the WMS two weeks in a row Sam would switch it off and go back to the spreadsheet.
